# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 10

**1** Jesus said: "I have thrown fire onto the world — and I am tending it until it catches."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Thrown fire" — "cast" rendered as a more physical, abrupt action
- "Tending it" — the watchful guardianship rendered as fire-tending; Jesus as fire-keeper
- "Until it catches" — "catches" for blazing; the fire needs to fully ignite
- The saying is compact: a two-beat rhythm — action done, now watching
